V1_oi_z2_ret1.rule: BTCUSDT 5-min bars (proxy for CME MBT), times America/Chicago. Features at bar open time t: OI_t = Binance 5-min open_interest with create_time == t (OI<=0 treated as missing); dOI_t = ln(OI_t/OI_(t-4h)); z_t = (dOI_t - m)/s with m, s the mean and sample std of dOI over the 8640 five-min bars strictly before t (>= 6912 non-missing required); ret4h_t = close_t/close_(t-4h) - 1. Trigger: z_t >= 2 and |ret4h_t| >= 1%. Evaluate the trigger on every tradable bar of a Monday-Friday calendar day with open time 00:00 .. 11:05 CT (before 11:08 CT); if flat, enter at the OPEN of the next 5-min bar with side = sign(ret4h_t) (long if up, short if down); at most one trade per day. No stop, no target. Exit at the 15:08 CT deadline = the open of the 15:10 CT bar of the same day (forced flat). Cost $3.82 per round turn.
